metadata.description: Qadvisor: An AI advisory board for Claude built on 17 documented thinking frameworks (Munger, Buffett, Jobs, Sun Tzu, Paul Graham, Karpathy and more): it reframes your question, consults the advisors in parallel, makes them debate disagreements, and hands you a verdict report.
